# Marcos Georgiou

> Hospitality transformation leader across the UK and Europe. 20+ years in senior operations. Led 200+ international site launches in 2.5 years (Deliveroo Editions, £14m budget, full P&L), opened Jamie's Italian in 23 countries plus 28 UK openings. Specialises in turnaround and recovery, international expansion, operating model design and rapid scale-up. Available now for COO, Operations Director and Head of Operations roles, and for interim, fractional and operating partner mandates.

Website: https://marcosgeorgiou.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcos-georgiou-91314371/
Based: United Kingdom. Open to European mandates.

## What he does

- **Turnaround and recovery:** stabilises operationally or financially distressed multi-site businesses by restoring governance and cost discipline.
- **International expansion:** builds operating models for new markets instead of copying the home-market playbook. Has built operating models from scratch twice.
- **Operating model design:** accountability, standards, financial controls and decision rights that let a business grow without the founder in every decision.
- **Rapid scale-up:** high-volume site launches without dropping standards.

Philosophy: "I give people a reliable way to succeed together."

## Career

- **MG Consultancy** (2020 to present, UK and Europe). Director of Operations and Operating Partner. Board-level advisory on growth, market entry and turnaround; operating model redesigns; governance frameworks; senior interim leadership. Stabilised a regulated department in three months.
- **GatepassUK** (Jul 2025 to Jan 2026). Chief Product Officer for an AI-enabled regulatory platform.
- **Considerate Constructors Scheme** (Jun 2024 to Aug 2025). Head of Product & Systems, Compliance & Risk.
- **YourKitchen, Amsterdam** (Aug 2020 to Aug 2022). Director of Operations and Co-Founder. Built operating infrastructure for ghost kitchen food brands.
- **The Student Hotel, Amsterdam, Berlin and Vienna** (Mar 2019 to Feb 2020). Food & Beverage Specialist. Launched the Berlin operation from scratch.
- **Deliveroo Editions** (UK and international). Global operating model rollout: 200+ sites in 2.5 years, £14m budget ownership with full P&L accountability.
- **Jamie's Italian** (global). Led international operations: 23 countries and 28 UK openings, with brand standards, QA and commercial controls embedded at pace.
